title: Adaptive cycle allocation: role-priority lattice and emergency scope-shed protocol
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We routinely hit mid-cycle staffing pressure where several concurrent priorities create unhealthy context switching and risk delivery of top-line initiatives. Current ad-hoc cuts cause morale/regression risk and opaque decision rationale.

Goal: Produce an operational playbook and a compact decision lattice that product, eng leads and people partners can use during weekly allocation checkpoints to: 1) rank role-level coverage by business criticality, 2) apply deterministic scope-shedding rules, and 3) activate emergency surge lanes with clear handoff and shadowing. The output should be a 1-page matrix + a checklist template for on-call and mid-cycle re-plan retro.

Why different: Instead of a simple priority list, the lattice maps role types (core infra, customer-facing fixes, feature shipping, platform stability, compliance) to three operational handles: postpone, short-sprint transfer, or preserve with buffer. This reduces arbitrary micro-trimming by making trade-offs visible and repeatable.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page Role-Priority Lattice graphic (SVG) accepted by Eng and PM leadership
A 6-step emergency scope-shed checklist with owners and linked runbooks
Two simulated re-planning war rooms ran in staging (no-customer-impact) with measured decision time < 45 minutes
Rollout doc + 3 training sessions scheduled for Eng Leads, PMs and People Ops before the next cycle planning window
plan: Week 1: Draft lattice and rules; run tabletop with Eng/PM (owner: Diego)
Week 2: Iterate with People Ops and Design; produce SVG + one-pager (owner: Claire Zhang)
Week 3: Pilot tabletop with two teams (Serving runtime team + Console); capture timing and friction points (owner: Ravi Shah)
Week 4: Finalize playbook, prepare training slides, and add checklist to Confluence; schedule rollout sessions (owner: Aisha)
Post-rollout: Quarterly retro + metric review to adjust thresholds and tie to cycle cadence
risks: Role granularity disagreement (eng leads may want team-specific rules) — mitigated by pilot plus allowed overrides logged in decision record
Perceived unfairness if certain teams experience repeated trims — mitigate via rotation constraint and surge credits ledger
Operational friction: people unfamiliar with the lattice may default to informal cuts — mitigate with rehearsals and mandated decision owner sign-off
metrics: Number of scope changes per ticket post-trim (target < 2 changes/ticket after finalization)
Team satisfaction survey post-cycle (NPS-style question specific to fairness; target > 6/10)
Fraction of preserved P0 work retained vs deferred (target > 90% preserved)
